title: Participating Practice Manual — Progress Records Paid Under the Patient's Dental PPO Plan
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders and Dental PPO Plans: progress records during covered treatment.** Progress records taken during covered treatment are part of the case fee. A records visit already paid under the patient's own Dental PPO Plans enrollment is therefore not paid a second time in the member's repayment.

**Progress records** are paid lines of that dental enrollment that meet all of these conditions:

- billed under the participation agreement named on the takeover entry;
- dated in or after the month coverage of the case began;
- dated after the latest transfer entry of the case, if there is one.

Two lines are tested, each being the latest of its code by date of service under that agreement (when two share a date, the one entered first):

- the latest panoramic image line (code D0330);
- the latest comprehensive oral evaluation line (code D0150).

| Which of those two latest lines are progress records | Amount that comes off the takeover benefit |
|---|---|
| both the D0330 line and the D0150 line | the plan payments of both lines |
| only the D0330 line | its plan payment |
| only the D0150 line, or neither | nothing |
| any, when the takeover entry names no agreement | nothing |

*Hypothetical figures:*

- Coverage began in April, there is no transfer entry, and the latest D0330 and D0150 lines under the agreement are both dated 12 June, with plan payments of 46.00 and 58.00. Then 104.00 comes off.
- If the latest D0150 line were dated 20 March, before coverage began, only the 46.00 would come off.
